method.tool: Vercel MCP deploy_to_vercel (target=production, name=proklinator-static, teamId omitted)
method.description: build.mjs fetches the 73 site files (2863472 B) from raw.githubusercontent.com (fallback: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh, 3 attempts per source on network errors / non-2xx / 30 s timeouts, 8 in flight; a hash or length mismatch is never retried on the same source and moves straight to the next one) at the pinned commit 168ea3b and aborts with exit 1 unless each file's byte length and SHA-256 match the values in `files` above, then writes them to ./public and re-reads the output tree to prove it holds exactly the manifest (nothing missing, nothing extra, sizes and hashes exact, total exact). The deployment therefore contains exactly the repo bytes of the pinned commit; this is the same pattern as the v20 … v20.7 deploys. The manifest was generated from the pinned commit's git blobs (git ls-tree -r -l + git cat-file blob; HEAD == origin/main == 168ea3b after a fresh fetch and fast-forward from b11a974, clean tree, every blob cross-checked against the working tree, 0 mismatches) and the script was dry-run locally before deploying with Node 22.14 (73/73 files fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com in 2.7 s and byte-identical to the checkout, output tree == manifest, no README / DEPLOY_RESULT / docs / tools / .gitignore / build.mjs / package.json in the output), together with a negative test (one tampered hash for app.js -> both sources rejected, public/app.js never written, the build aborts with exit 1 after 72/73) and a fallback test (raw host replaced by an unreachable name -> all 73 files come from cdn.jsdelivr.net in 23.7 s, still byte-identical). package.json pins engines.node 22.x. The raw deployment URL served the verified v20.7.1 index at the first poll (20:28:02Z, as soon as the deploy call returned) and the public alias was on v20.7.1 at 20:28:14Z.

notes: The repository is public (gh: visibility PUBLIC), which is what makes the unauthenticated pinned-commit fetch in build.mjs possible. If the repo is ever made private, this deploy method needs a token or an inline file tree.

The local checkout booted at b11a974 (merge of PR #19, v20.7 record); origin/main was fetched first and fast-forwarded to 168ea3b (merge of PR #20) before the manifest was generated, so the pinned SHA is the latest main named in the task.
Git-linked auto-deploy was not used, for the same reasons as before: create_git_project requires teamId (the 403 trigger) and cannot re-link the existing unlinked project proklinator-static.

teamId was omitted from deploy_to_vercel, as in the prior successful deploys; no 403 occurred. Team-scoped read endpoints were again not usable for this token (get_deployment and get_deployment_build_logs with the known team id or slug -> 404 'Deployment not found'), so the build was followed and verified over HTTP against the raw deployment URL and the public alias.

The existing project proklinator-static was reused (protection already off); no new project was created and no auth/SSO/protection settings were touched. Registration and payments were not opened. Auth stays NO-GO.

README.md, DEPLOY_RESULT.json, docs/ (including docs/content), .gitignore and tools/build_assets.py stay out of the deployment; ATTRIBUTIONS.md and assets/fx/LICENSE-kenney.txt stay in so the CC0 / ISC / OFL attributions travel with the served files.

The headless smoke wrote only to the headless browser's own throwaway profiles (pk_intro_v20 gate record, one history entry, one pk_game record per run); the site has no backend and nothing was sent anywhere. The toBlob hook used to reach the off-DOM OG canvas was injected by the DevTools debugger into the headless browser only. tesseract-ocr (rus) was installed in the agent VM solely for the optional OCR pass.

SAFETY_BURN_IN itself (the const and the wording «Шутка, не угроза») already existed in v20.7; what is new live is drawSafetyBand / SAFETY_INK / SAFETY_SOOT / SAFETY_RULE and the fixed-Y band geometry — hence the pre-deploy check recorded SAFETY_BURN_IN 2× but drawSafetyBand 0× on the old v20.7 app.js.
No app code was changed for this deploy; this commit updates DEPLOY_RESULT.json only.
